title: Patch: Galaxia's Attack goes to the first Unit played each turn only, not to the second when the first did not stay on the field
notes: Issue #4826: S+ #74 Galaxia now records grantedTurn on any resolved Unit play of her controller's that resolves while she stands, and buffs only if the Unit still stands face-up on the field, so a first Unit that left the field during resolution does not give the Attack to the second Unit played that turn (R4826000).

player.title: Galaxia buffs the first Unit played only
fixes: Galaxia no longer gives her Attack buff to the second Unit played in a turn when the first Unit left the field as its play resolved.
